notes.title: Improved Local Co-Op Option, Chinese language Fixes & Discord QR Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]What’s new:
[/b][/h2][p]• Added a checkbox in the settings to enable local multiplayer using Keyboard/Mouse + Controller → (See image below for updated controls) 
• Fixed an issue where Chinese characters would disappear 
• Updated default settings to launch the game in 120 FPS & high quality 
• Fixed the QR code not appearing in the main menu → Now links directly to our Discord server upon clicking.
• Small collision bug fixes
[/p][p][i]Thanks again for playing Wires and Whiskers and for all your feedback! [/i]ːsteamhappyː

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704466/cbe3fe6e00996ae747eaab5d2bc754d72645302d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update – Localization Support, Checkpoint Saves
notes.notes: [h1][b]We’ve released a small update to improve usability and accessibility![/b][/h1][p]---[/p][h3] 🈯 Localization Menu[/h3][p]- Players can now switch between supported languages[/p][p]- Language changes apply immediately without restart[/p][p][/p][h3]💾 Checkpoint Saves (New)[/h3][p]- Game now saves progress at key checkpoints[/p][p]- If you quit or fail, you’ll restart from your last checkpoint[/p][p]- Helps streamline retry flow without losing full progress[/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 Other Tweaks[/h3][p]- Minor improvements to settings UI[/p][p]- Small performance optimizations[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Let us know on Discord if you notice any bugs or have feedback about the new systems![/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Minor Update – QR Menu, Remote Play Improvements, A/D Support
notes.notes: [p][i]We’ve pushed a small update based on your feedback![/i][/p][h2][/h2][h3][b]What’s new:[/b][/h3][p]- Added a **QR code** on the main menu for quick Discord access[/p][p]- Improved **Steam Remote Play Together** support (more reliable controller detection)[/p][p]- You can now use **A/D keys** to switch characters on the selection screen (for keyboard users)[/p][p][/p][p][i][u]Note:[/u] Keyboard play is still designed around a single player using **mouse + keyboard**, but A/D now gives you more flexibility if you still want to use only the keyboard.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes & Optimizations:[/b][/h3][p]- Fixed various minor bugs[/p][p]- Optimized main menu performance[/p][p][/p]
